title: Gjallarhorn
description: This datapack allows you to give yourself an OP Goat Horn which has the function of dealing unlimited damage to those around you.
body:
# What is this?
This **datapack** adds an incredibly powerful new item: **an Overpowered Goat Horn (Gjallarhorn)** that unleashes a devastating shockwave, dealing **unlimited damage** to all nearby entities. With a single use, you can easily clear out mobs and dominate any combat situation. Perfect for players who want to feel unstoppable and add a dramatic twist to their Minecraft gameplay. Easy to use and fully integrated, this tool transforms how you interact with the world around you.
